name: spec-progress
description: A panel above the prompt that follows Spec Kit specs: flow steps, phases, current task, checkpoints, live progress and buttons that fill the prompt. Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, pt, es, fr, de or it

modelContext.title: Tell the model the active spec
modelContext.description: on adds a short note to the system prompt naming the active spec and phase, so the model follows tasks.md in order and checks tasks off; off sends nothing
